name: Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival
description:
Dive into the ruthless world beneath the waves in Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival. In the endless blue of the ocean, only the strongest predator survives. Begin your journey as a hungry hunter and carve your path through a living underwater world filled with danger, prey, and powerful rivals. Every hunt makes you stronger, every battle pushes you closer to the top of the food chain. The ocean is vast, beautiful, and unforgiving — and it’s time to prove that you are its true ruler.

Key Features:
• Explore a Living Ocean – Swim through vibrant coral reefs, mysterious underwater caves, sunlit lagoons, and dark abyssal depths filled with life and hidden dangers.
• Hunt to Survive – Track down fish, sea creatures, and rival sharks while fighting for food and territory in intense underwater encounters.
• Evolve Your Predator – Upgrade your shark’s speed, bite power, and endurance to become faster, stronger, and deadlier with every evolution.
• Multiple Shark Species – Play as different types of sharks, each offering a unique style of hunting and survival.
• Rise to the Top of the Food Chain – Grow from a lone hunter into the ultimate ocean predator feared by everything beneath the waves.
• Easy and Intuitive Controls – Swim, strike, and tear through prey with fluid controls designed for smooth underwater action.

The ocean is a battlefield where only the strongest endure. Hunt, evolve, and dominate the deep as you become a legend of the seas in Shark Simulator: Ocean RPG Survival.
